author: Bbodz
quote: So I’ll start with the only positive I can think of, the graphics are great, and driving around a virtual Miami is kind of cool for a short while I guess. That earns the game a single point rather than a 0.  It feels nothing like a GTA game, what happened to the wacky main characters with a wild plot line that feels like it was written by somebody who understands their audience? Where is the dopamine hot of completing a cool mission and seeing the cool ‘mission complete’ screens with added music etc…It was clear in previous GTA games that the team understood that they’re ripping into outrageous parts of society in a satirical way to please a vast majority of people, and ironically it was this humour that in fact highlighted the things they were ripping into even more, the releases would be really controversial and result in silly IRL news stories about GTA being responsible for psychopaths and serial killers, which was blatantly false and a political agenda against the contents of the game; people understood this and loved them for it. With GTA 6, instead of using humour reflective of the current state of the world, this game feels like it was made to please 35-40 year old women. To my mind this group are likely not making up a majority of the target audience for a grand theft auto game. Therefore, I don’t understand why they ever thought this story was a good idea?Jason feels dry, like an empty shell of a man, happy to exist as his girlfriend’s slave. Clearly this is the intention as the first several hours are spent doing boring tasks to please Lucia. The voice acting is horrific as well. I want a refund and will never buy a rockstar game without a disc again. The above makes me think that they knew about the poor story, performance issues a long time ago, and decided they’re going to cash in their chips with this release by removing the option to resell. I think they knew that people wouldn’t have wanted to keep hold of that disc for more than a couple of weeks.
